title: Manual check in the DAW: march-blues and iv-of-ab-minor sets against apricity render
description:
## Intent

Prove the M1 set in the DAW, where a machine can't.

## Steps (manual, the owner with the DAW)

1. `apricity sources fetch --all` (or `apricity sync pull`) so the examples' samples are present.
2. `apricity export --daw-set examples/march-blues.apr -o /tmp/daw/march-blues.als` and the same for `examples/iv-of-ab-minor.apr`.
3. Open each set: no error dialog; tempo and time signature right; clips on the grid; locators at the chord changes.
4. `apricity render examples/march-blues.apr -o /tmp/daw/mb.wav`; play both and compare: same timing, same chords (mix differences are expected until M3).
5. Move the set folder elsewhere and reopen: no missing samples.

## Verification

A comment on this task with the DAW version, the outcome of each step and any mismatch filed as a bug under this epic.

## Release

No commit.
